verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region or residency is a fair question for a cloud provider, so the axis applies. However, no item in the pack documents region selection or data-residency controls for stored data. Community posts that merely name a region in passing (a committed-use purchase, a zone outage) do not show a residency capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
